spans.s:
पेय पेय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. पा), to be
drunk or quaffed, fit to be drunk, drinkable, potable;
tastable, sapid; (अस्), m., scil. यज्ञ-क्रतु, a
drink offering, libation (Ved.); (आ), f. rice gruel;
any drink with a small quantity of boiled rice; the
decoction of anything after straining; a species of
anise, = मिश्रेया; (अम्), n. a drink, beverage.

पेयूष पेयूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (= पीयूष,
q. v), the milk of a cow that has calved within seven
days, biestings; fresh butter; nectar, Amṛta.
